general_information.Description: "-Objective: Develop students' competence in applying linguistic and specific knowledge for handling translation of ESP documents. -Description: The course aims to delve into the translating practice of specialized documents in various fields. In addition to assisting learners to build up their own specialized glossaries, techniques and common specific knowledge, the course focuses on the translating practice of divergent documents covering such fields as literature, technology/IT, Legal/politics, medicine, and so on. The course can be implemented in the forms of projects, exhibits or workshop, and so on. -Teaching method: Communicative approach

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Apply linguistics and specific knowledge in handling translation tasks
Analyze ESP documents in term of specific norms, language and knowledge
Translate ESP texts with precision, accuracy and consistency
Formulate a wide range of knowledge as well as topic-based vocabulary and structures for ESP translation
Foster skills of critical thinking and team work with professional working attitude and ethics

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills which student obtained in the delivered sessions 1-5. Content based on topics of studied units
assessments.Grading Guide: Translating technical documents: * English-Vietnamese * Technical document of 1000-1500 words

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills which student obtained in the delivered sessions 6-7. Content based on topics of studied units
assessments.Grading Guide: Translating IT /Engineering documents: * Vietnamese - English * Technical document of 1500-2000 words

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation skills which student obtained in the delivered sessions 8-9, and the techniques/skills/methods they applied in translating Content based on topics of studied units
assessments.Grading Guide: (1) Translating Medical/Legal/Literature documents: * English - Vietnamese * Technical document of 1000-2500 words (2) Providing analysis for the methods/techniques/skills used in translating, including: * Theoretical background for the methods * Skills/techniques to deal with challenging words/phrases/structures
